standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: The Great Guardian wants you to know that there has been a development in our fight against the Abyss.
A magical signal has been detected emerging from the rift. It is not of the Abyss.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.player: Hmm... I was actually hoping to enter the Scar myself. Perhaps I could investigate this signal while I'm in there.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: Nothing can survive the Scar. To enter would not be wise.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.player: But how do you know nothing can survive? Has anyone actually confirmed that?

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: There are a few who have entered the Scar in the past. None have returned.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.player: Well then give me a chance to be the first.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: If you wish to enter, it is not our place to stop you. In the likely event of your demise, you will be mourned.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.player: Thanks... I think. Anything I should know before entering?

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: The rift is unpredictable. Normally, you would not be able to control its destination. However, the magical signal coming from within could be of benefit. It could act as a guide.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.player: So you'd be able to send me right to the source?
Well I suppose that's the best I can ask for.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: Are you ready to enter the Scar?

steps.npc: Then may your death come quick, human. Good luck.

steps.text: Player is transported to the Scar.

steps.npc: Then speak to me once you are.

standard-dialogue-during-desert-treasure.npc: How unexpected. The Great Guardian will need to be informed.
In the meantime, do you wish to return to the Scar?

steps.text: Player is transported to the Scar.

steps.npc: Speak to me again if you do.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-de.npc: Do you wish to return to the Scar?

steps.text: Player is transported to the Scar.

steps.npc: Speak to me again if you do.
